name: TikTok profile stats (followers, plays, engagement) to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## TikTok profile stats to Google Sheets
Daily snapshot of public TikTok accounts: followers, total likes, video count, average and median plays, engagement rate and posting cadence of the latest posts. One new row per profile per day, so the sheet becomes a growth history.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Credentials > New > *Header Auth*. Name it `Apify API token`. Header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > Integrations).
2. Open the Google Sheets node(s), connect Google Sheets OAuth2, and replace `YOUR_SHEET_ID` (and the tab name if needed).
3. Edit the `profiles` list in *Run Apify actor* (usernames or profile URLs; public accounts only).
4. Click *Execute workflow* to test with the small sample input, then activate.

Runs the Apify actor https://apify.com/transparent_meteorite/tiktok-public-profile-scraper (pay-per-result; the free Apify plan credit covers a trial). Maintained by the author of the actor.
